verdict.rationale: Gemini in Firebase provides a natural-language chat interface inside the Firebase console. It answers product questions, generates code, and shortens troubleshooting (firebase-docs-21, firebase-docs-13). With Crashlytics it also gives AI crash debugging with root causes and suggested fixes (firebase-docs-14, firebase-docs-25). The MCP server is an editor-side integration, not a dashboard assistant, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of generating Firestore/database queries in the console, evidence that the assistant explains the user's own backend configuration rather than general Firebase features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
